tool.name: GEMMA Univariate LMM
tool.description: Perform univariate linear mixed model analysis using GEMMA

param.name: pheno_column
param.label: Phenotype column number
param.help: Which column in the phenotype file to use (1-based index)

tool.help:
**GEMMA Univariate Linear Mixed Model**
This tool performs univariate linear mixed model analysis using GEMMA.
Command equivalent: docker run -v $(pwd)/example:/data -w /data --rm galaxy-gemma:0.98.6 \ gemma -g mouse_hs1940.geno.txt.gz -p mouse_hs1940.pheno.txt -n 1 \ -a mouse_hs1940.anno.txt -k output/mouse_hs1940.cXX.txt -lmm \ -o mouse_hs1940_CD8_lmm
For more information, see the GEMMA manual: https://github.com/genetics-statistics/GEMMA
